summary: CaliberCos Inc. filed a prospectus (424B5) registering 2,162,791 shares of Class A common stock for resale by selling stockholders who converted $3.45 million of outstanding notes into equity in March 2026. The shares include those issuable upon conversion of Series AAA Convertible Preferred Stock. The company receives no proceeds; the event is a routine shelf registration to fulfill contractual registration rights. No merger, tender, activism, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a standard capital markets disclosure, not a special situation.
